# GitHub Configuration Directory (`.github/`)

## Purpose
The `.github/` directory manages GitHub repository settings, issue and pull request templates, automation actions, workflow definitions, and governance files for AI TradeQ.

## Responsibilities
- Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) GitHub Actions workflows.
- Issue templates for bug reports and feature requests.
- Pull request code review guidelines and PR templates.
- Repository ownership configuration (`CODEOWNERS`).
